question:
A cube (dice) has six different numbers drawn over its six faces. Three different positions of this cube are shown in the given figure. Which number is on the face opposite to ‘1’?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/738c4e3785e216a25d1205e1faa1a6855f0b9d379d47219aad2f6829fc048ead.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of '1', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b75db4fd3ea71d5b5a3b8c25f888a9408acdda6d170b001df5800166de7850c8.png] 

From
 both dices, 3 is common so we can rotate in clockwise/anticlockwise direction starting from 3.

4 is opposite to 2.

3 is opposite to 6.

So, 1 will be opposite to 5.

Hence, the correct answer is "5".
